# Trip Printables

> Free travel planning templates: itineraries, packing lists, budgets, and more.

Trip Printables publishes genuinely usable travel planning templates, one template per page,
each explained in real detail rather than presented as a bare thumbnail in a gallery. Every
template is available as a "Make a copy" Google Docs or Sheets link, or as a downloadable PDF,
with no account or email required to view it. A paid Complete Trip Planning Kit bundles
editable versions of everything plus bonus templates for people who want the full system.

## Key Pages

- [Travel Itinerary Template](https://tripprintables.com/templates/travel-itinerary-template/): day-by-day trip planner with a bookings tracker and emergency info block
- [Itinerary Template, Google Docs](https://tripprintables.com/templates/itinerary-template-google-docs/): document-format version of the itinerary template
- [Itinerary Template, Google Sheets](https://tripprintables.com/templates/itinerary-template-google-sheets/): spreadsheet-format version with a running cost total
- [All Templates](https://tripprintables.com/templates/): full template library
- [Complete Trip Planning Kit](https://tripprintables.com/premium/): the paid bundle

## About

Built and maintained as a small, focused publisher of free travel tools. No account walls,
no dark patterns, one genuinely useful template per page.
